## Professional Overview
Sumit Rathor (also referenced as Sumit Rathore) is a Full Stack Software Engineer pursuing a B.Tech in Computer Science & Design at Madhav Institute of Technology & Science (MITS), Gwalior (CGPA 8.09). He completed a research internship at DRDO-CFEES (Centre for Fire, Explosive and Environment Safety, Ministry of Defence, Delhi), served as Project Admin for GirlScript Summer of Code 2025, and was President of the Innovation & DIY Club at MITS Gwalior. He specializes in React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, PHP, MySQL, PostgreSQL, C++, Data Structures & Algorithms, offline AI/RAG workflows (Ollama, LangChain, ChromaDB), and IoT systems.

## Core Technical Competencies
- **Languages:** JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, Python, PHP, C / C++, SQL, HTML5, CSS3.
- **Frontend Frameworks & Libraries:** React.js, Next.js, Vite, Bootstrap 5, Tailwind CSS, Three.js.
- **Backend & APIs:** Node.js, Express.js, PHP, CodeIgniter 4, RESTful APIs, AJAX, WebSockets, Supabase (Auth, RLS, Realtime).
- **AI, RAG & Vector Systems:** LangChain, Ollama (Local LLMs), ChromaDB, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Streamlit, Vector Embeddings, PyPDF, Google Gemini API.
- **Databases & Cloud:** MySQL, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Vercel, Git & GitHub, GitHub Actions.
- **IoT & Embedded:** ESP32-CAM, L298N Motor Drivers, Computer Vision, Arduino.

## Flagship Projects & Case Studies (11 Projects)

1. **Enterprise Local Knowledge Assistant (Rakshak AI) - DRDO CFEES**
   - Offline, air-gapped RAG assistant for querying internal technical documents and engineering manuals locally.
   - Stack: Python, Streamlit, LangChain, Ollama (Local LLM), ChromaDB, PyPDF, RAG Architecture.
   - Case Study: https://sumitrathor.vercel.app/projects/rakshak-ai/
   - GitHub: https://github.com/sumitrathor1/Rakshak-AI-Ragbot

2. **Certificate Authentication & Verification Portal**
   - React platform for instant live-camera QR certificate verification, multi-page PDF QR scanning, and bulk Excel-to-QR ZIP generation.
   - Stack: React, JavaScript, PDF.js, SheetJS, Google Apps Script API.
   - Case Study: https://sumitrathor.vercel.app/projects/certificate-portal/
   - Live Demo: https://innovation-and-diy-certificate.vercel.app/

3. **Hardware Inventory & Borrowing Portal**
   - Campus hardware borrowing and inventory system with Gmail OTP authentication, Supabase Row-Level Security (RLS), and atomic stock updates.
   - Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, Supabase PostgreSQL, Supabase Auth, Nodemailer, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
   - Case Study: https://sumitrathor.vercel.app/projects/hardware-inventory/
   - Live Demo: https://innovation-and-diy-inventory.vercel.app/

4. **Innovation & DIY Club Website**
   - Official student innovation and technical community showcase platform for MITS Gwalior.
   - Stack: React 19, Vite, JavaScript, CSS.
   - Case Study: https://sumitrathor.vercel.app/projects/innovation-diy-club/

5. **11acre.ai - Real Estate & PropTech Platform**
